name: dev.wraps/email
description: Query SES send history, delivery events, domains and suppressions, and send from your AWS account.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_REGION
environmentVariables.description: Region your Wraps stack is deployed in. Optional only if your active AWS profile supplies one — SES identities are per-region.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: AWS profile to use. Credentials are read locally and never leave the machine.

environmentVariables.name: WRAPS_WRITE_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to enable the send_email tool. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: WRAPS_FROM_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Default from address for send_email. Must be a domain verified in your SES account.

environmentVariables.name: WRAPS_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated addresses the agent may send to. Restricts send_email when write mode is on.

environmentVariables.name: WRAPS_ALLOWED_RECIPIENT_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated domains the agent may send to. Matching is exact; list subdomains explicitly.

environmentVariables.name: WRAPS_HISTORY_TABLE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: DynamoDB table holding email history. Defaults to wraps-email-history.
